documents.title: Weather mast maintenance
documents.body_md: The weather mast records a sensor reading every ninety seconds. The battery enclosure is checked at sunrise.

documents.title: Lantern parade briefing
documents.body_md: Lantern parade volunteers assemble beside the north pier gate. Reflective sashes are handed out before the procession.

documents.title: Film archive handling
documents.body_md: The film negatives are sealed in acid-free envelopes. A soft brush removes loose dust before each sleeve is closed.

documents.title: Estuary paddling notice
documents.body_md: A red flag means the estuary launch is closed to paddlers. The rescue boat remains on its trailer beside the ramp.

documents.title: Paper conservation journal
documents.body_md: The damp paper rests between absorbent blotters for eight minutes. The sheet is then transferred to the drying rack.

documents.title: Coffee cupping worksheet
documents.body_md: Each coffee cupping bowl receives twelve grams of ground coffee. The grinder dial is set to fourteen.

documents.title: Pollinator enclosure rota
documents.body_md: Farah inspects the pollinator enclosure on Tuesdays. The inspection log is kept beside the mesh entrance.

documents.title: Choir rehearsal cupboard
documents.body_md: The choir scores are filed in the mahogany cupboard in the east alcove. Used pencils go in the shallow tray.

documents.title: Glasshouse ventilation settings
documents.body_md: The glasshouse roof vents open when the air reaches 27 degrees Celsius. The work team checks the opening motor monthly.

documents.title: Glasshouse ventilation settings
documents.body_md: The glasshouse roof vents open when the air reaches 21 degrees Celsius. The research team checks the opening motor weekly.

documents.title: Listening room access
documents.body_md: The listening room door code is 4826. The work team returns the brass key to the reception desk.

documents.title: Listening room access
documents.body_md: The listening room door code is 7319. The research team returns the brass key to the upstairs office.
